title: Physical activity trait predicted effector genes (Qi G et al. 2022)
bodyHtml:
This table displays results from the study:

Genome-wide association studies of 27 accelerometry-derived physical activity measurements identified novel loci and genetic mechanisms.
Qi G, et al.
Genet Epidemiol. 2022 Mar;46(2):122-138. doi: 10.1002/gepi.22441.
PMID: 35043453

The authors performed a GWAS for 27 wrist accelerometry-derived physical activity measurements obtained from 88,411 UK Biobank participants. They then performed a transcriptome-wide association analysis (TWAS; Gusev et al. 2016) across the 18 traits with at least one genome-wide significant GWAS variant and across 48 tissues from GTEx v7. Fifteen loci had significant association after correcting for multiple testing (Benjamini-Hochberg corrected p-value < 2.5 × 10−6). The authors also colocalized eQTLs (across GTEx v7) with the GWAS signals.

The table below includes predictions of the effector gene at each of the 15 TWAS significant loci. Mouse over the column headers for more details about each evidence type.
